chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “A man performed the fajr salat when dawn had risen.” So he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْفَجْرَ: the fajr prayer or dawn time, according to context
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Salat al-Fajr as soon as dawn rises?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing the fajr salat at the time dawn rises is unobjectionable. It serves as a jurisprudential indication regarding the beginning time of Salat al-Fajr in Shia fiqh.
